merged.title: Make a retried request id wait for the original commit
merged.summary: A retry with the same requestId as a commit that was still being fsynced got DUPLICATE straight away. The original wasn't durable or published yet, so if its sync then failed, the client had been told "done" for something that was lost.

merged.title: conformance: avoid nil Group panic in listener status matchers
merged.summary: gatewayListenersMatch and listenerSetListenersMatch default an omitted Group on each expected supported kind, but they did it inside the loop over the actual kinds if the actual list is empty the loop never runs, Group stays nil and the "not found" log line dereferences it and…

merged.title: conformance: fix parentRefToString printing a pointer address
merged.summary: parentRefToString checks *p.Namespace != "" correctly, but then formats p.Namespace, the pointer, so %v prints an address

merged.title: Publish the recovered log end as the first checkpoint's lsn
merged.summary: If recovery doesn't replay any commit, the first checkpoint after it put the old lsn back. That left the WAL records of a transaction that never committed inside the replay window.

merged.title: Add configurable display format for time filters
merged.summary: Native Time Range filters currently display evaluated ranges using raw ISO-style values (e.g. 2019-01-14), with no way to configure how they're shown.

merged.title: Handle self-referential catalog qualifiers
merged.summary: DB engine specs without catalog support (e.g. MssqlEngineSpec, which has supports_catalog = False) do not model a catalog-qualified permission/dataset identity.

merged.title: Use FILTER_STATE_CACHE_CONFIG timeout for dynamic filter option queries
merged.summary: Dynamic native filter option queries currently go through /api/v1/chart/data, which causes them to use DATA_CACHE_CONFIG. This leads to stale dropdown values, especially in cases involving frequently changing data or RLS.

merged.title: Restore arrow key navigation in modal inputs opened from dropdown
merged.summary: Fixes an issue where keyboard navigation keys (Arrow Left/Right/Up/Down, Home, End) did not work inside input fields in modals opened from the dashboard header dropdown (e.g., “Save as” dashboard modal and “Theme & CSS” modal).

merged.title: Safely render database URIs in startup warnings
merged.summary: This PR improves startup warning output by explicitly rendering database URIs with hidden passwords when metadata database connection checks fail.

merged.title: Resolve SECRET_KEY lazily to fix silent re-encrypt-secrets failures
merged.summary: Fixes an issue where superset re-encrypt-secrets could silently fail to rotate encrypted database secrets.
